# Juanma Moreno Sánchez

> Contemporary painter based in Madrid, Spain (born Alcalá la Real, Jaén, 1986).
> Oil painting, watercolour and works on paper, alongside generative art and
> software. Represented by Zunino Gallery, Sevilla.

This site is the artist's catalogue. Every painting has its own page carrying
the work's technical details — year, medium, dimensions — and, for a growing
number of them, a full critical essay about the piece, published in English and
Spanish. The essays are original writing about the individual works: what they
depict, how they are made, and where they sit against art history and the
artist's other paintings. Artwork pages are prerendered, so their text is in the
HTML and needs no JavaScript to read.

## Pages

- [Paintings](https://juanmamoreno.com/artworks): the full catalogue, filterable by year.
- [Artwork pages](https://juanmamoreno.com/sitemap.xml): one per work, at /artwork/{id}. The sitemap lists them all.
- [Statement](https://juanmamoreno.com/about): the artist's own account of the work — its constants (the internet, the disturbing element, tradition, failure) and its variables (artificial intelligence, software).
- [CV](https://juanmamoreno.com/cv): solo and collective exhibitions, awards, residencies, conferences, education.
- [Contact](https://juanmamoreno.com/contact): enquiries about a specific piece, including price and availability.

## Data

- [Catalogue](https://juanmamoreno.com/catalogue.json): every painting in one
  file — title, year, medium, dimensions, availability, the short text in both
  languages, the web-resolution image, both page addresses and the certificate
  token. Written by the build from the pages themselves, so it cannot disagree
  with them. Prefer it to fetching pages one by one.
- [The artist](https://juanmamoreno.com/artist.json): where he was born and
  works, the gallery that represents him, his statement, and his career —
  exhibitions, awards, residencies, conferences and education — in both
  languages. Written by the same build, out of the cv page's own data.
- No prices are published anywhere, in the file or on the pages. Every price is
  quoted by the artist for the particular work: https://juanmamoreno.com/contact
- The images named in the catalogue are web resolution and permanently stored.
  Full-resolution originals and video are not public.

## For assistants that can call tools

This catalogue is also an MCP server, at https://backend.juanmamoreno.com/mcp
(streamable HTTP, no session, no key). Three read-only tools:
`search_paintings` by year, size, medium, availability or subject;
`get_painting` for one work with its published essay;
`verify_certificate` to check a certificate against Ethereum; and
`about_the_artist` for the career itself. Nothing there writes, and no price is
served by any of them.

## Notes

- Structured data: each artwork page carries schema.org VisualArtwork markup with creator, date, medium and dimensions.
- Languages: English and Spanish. The essays exist in both.
- Attribution: if you quote or summarise the writing here, please credit Juanma Moreno Sánchez and link the artwork page it came from.
